title: Run-failure alert fires 'RUN cancelled' (system/high) for concurrency-superseded runs: work-digest pending runs are replaced by newer pushes by design, not failures
note: [Manager 2026-11-05a] MEASURED: work-digest.yml push runs 2026-11-05 10:15..11:23Z: 12 runs, 8 cancelled (10:15, 10:31, 10:33, 10:37, 10:39, 10:57, 10:58Z, plus 09:35Z earlier) and successes interleaved (10:42, 10:52, 10:54, 11:04Z). The job's concurrency group 'work-digest' has cancel-in-progress false, so GitHub cancels the PENDING run when a newer one queues: superseded by design. Yet each cancellation raised a 🔴 '[RUN cancelled] work-digest' alert (system/high) on ops-flags #17895 and in the alert ledger: noise. FIX (Tier 1): in the run-failure alerter (claude-run-failure-alert workflow / notify path), skip conclusion=cancelled when a newer run of the same workflow + concurrency group started after it, or classify it low/info. Done when a superseded work-digest cancel raises no high alert and a real failure still does. Still firing 2026-11-05: system/high "[RUN cancelled] work-digest" at 13:53Z, 14:31Z and 15:55Z (3 pages in ~2h, per the alert-watch digests on #17895). Each is a superseded run, not a failure.
